hero.title: 创意写作应用
hero.summary: 面向长线创作任务的具体应用，强调叙事连续性、角色一致性、时间线管理和长期设定资产。

taskTemplates.title: 推进长线创作
taskTemplates.goal: 输入世界观、角色、当前章节目标和连续性约束，推进一段创作任务。
taskTemplates.description: 适合长篇叙事、设定维护和章节推进。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 推进长线创作并保持连续性

hero.title: Creative Writing
hero.summary: A focused application for long-form creative work. It emphasizes narrative continuity, character consistency, timeline management, and durable story assets.

taskTemplates.title: Advance a long-form creative project
taskTemplates.goal: Provide the world setting, characters, the current chapter goal, and continuity constraints to advance a creative task.
taskTemplates.description: For long-form narratives, world-building maintenance, and chapter development.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Advance long-form creative work while preserving continuity
